why: Серия «Балкон до и после»: формула преображения с конкретной болью и числом, на которой ваш ролик «балкон + пергола» набрал 47 359 просмотров; в кадре только реальные застеклённые балконы, веранды и перголы. Цель — охват и заявки на замер балкона.
rules: Roman Group (ArtVitrage) works ONLY with glass. Main product (about 2 of 3 videos): frameless glazing of balconies and verandas (windows for balconies), pergolas, balcony blinds. Also: stained glass, decorative mirrors, glass kitchen backsplashes (skinali), glass partitions. EVERY shot must clearly show glass work as the main subject. Forbidden shots: kitchens or rooms where cabinets, appliances or furniture are the subject and no glass is clearly visible in focus; furniture or cabinets being built or assembled; woodwork; drinking glasses, glassware, bottles or jars; tiles, plaster or other trades; mosques, churches and religious images (synagogue stained glass only from his own photos). Never mention furniture. No prices, no deadlines, no client names, no other companies' objects.

problems: Frames 1-3 (0.9s, 2.8s, 4.6s) are near-identical static shots of the same balcony, so the opening feels slow and the thumb is not stopped
Frames 5-7 (8.3s, 10.1s, 12.0s) repeat the same building facade, so the video feels static
No before/after: the voice says 'open balcony, dust, wind, heat' but the picture only shows already glazed balconies
The glass is far away and small in the facade shots, with no close-up of frameless panels, sliding or the finished work
The 6.5s frame is a distant street shot with trees covering the balcony, so glass is barely visible
qa.fix: Open with a dynamic before shot of an open balcony in dust or wind, then show close-ups of frameless glass panels being installed and sliding, then a bright finished balcony; use different angles instead of repeated facade shots, large full-sentence subtitles, and a CTA over a glass shot.
